description: The keys a rule may use in when:. ACE owns the keys; ASC fills the values from live data and matches. Which keys a start kind supplies is ASC's start-request contract, not here.

keys.description: What kind of start this is.
Agent CLI id (claude, codex, agy, pi, omp).
Head or unit role (lead, producer, reviewer, ...).

componentScope: No component key. A unit with scope component is owned by its component (owner) and applies like any other rule; its when: is empty (always), which keeps today's repo projection byte-identical. Narrowing by component later adds a key here first.
